title: One language model for every point: the export of every decision set, any point's state, a comparison per point
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice; 29.9 widens 26.4's language model from six column points to every point with a set, the training run being the owner's.
plan: Read every decision set into one export, the workflow rows given the shape the others have.
Let the model answerer and its prompt take any point's state, within what a state may hold.
Compare any answerer per point on every point's dev rows, a workflow decision scored against every answer its journey accepts.

decisions.decision: A new export folder (export_v2) beside 22.5's export_v1.
decisions.why: export_v1's manifest says what an earlier run trained on; a widened export is another dataset, not an edit of that one.

decisions.decision: A workflow row is normalised where it is read: the point's choices, a subject, the rule's recorded answer.
decisions.why: The workflow sets were written by 26.3 for its classifiers; one function makes every builder read them, without rewriting the sets.

decisions.decision: The answerer drops its column-only guard but checks every state against the ledger's state fields before sending it.
decisions.why: Every point's state is bands, counts and codes by the ledger's contract; the guard by subject kind was the wrong check, the state check is the right one.

decisions.decision: A decision with one option is counted apart in the comparison.
decisions.why: Any answer to it is right: 102 of 220 solution.route decisions have one option, and a model that always answers the first scored 0.95 there.

change: dclab_core: decision_export.normalize and by_point_split, ModelAnswerer for any point (a state the ledger would not keep is never sent), compare with accepted answers and single-option counts, the decision_answer prompt for any state (dclab-core 0.83.0); dclab_rnd: decision_export reads the four set folders into export_v2, decision_model_compare every point's dev rows, the lake the workflow sets, the lake's answer source skips them (the workflow source asks them), a sealed journey set is played into the workflow sets only once its gate read it; the recipe points at export_v2.

findings.defect: Two lake tests failed on the owner's tree.
findings.scenario: The test build patched the three generated folders but not the new workflow one, so it read the real workflow rows: 44 rows where 1 was expected.
findings.cause: A new source read through a module path the tests did not redirect; the gate's worktree has no workflow rows (gitignored), so it passed there.
findings.fix: The test redirects the workflow folder too, and a test builds a workflow row into the lake.

findings.defect: A sealed journey set not yet read could become training rows.
findings.scenario: A fresh sealed set committed, the workflow sets collected before its gate ran, then the export and the lake: its people in train.chat.jsonl and the lake's train split.
findings.cause: Collecting took every sealed journey set, read or not; today every one has been read, so nothing leaked yet.
findings.fix: A sealed journey set is played only once its gate stored a result; the export's limits say the workflow points have no sealed set left.
findings.impact: A later sealed verdict would have been read on journeys a tuned model had learned from.

findings.defect: target.column and labels.join_key were not covered and not declared left.
findings.scenario: The plan assigns them to 29.9; the export reads the four set folders only.
findings.cause: They are a ranking of columns, not a choice among options, and their set lives in the lake (OpenML).
findings.fix: Declared left in the status with why; the lake's own export carries the OpenML set.

findings.defect: The answerer no longer checked what it sends.
findings.scenario: A caller passing a state with free text (a person's words) would have it sent to the decision_answer purpose.
findings.cause: The removed guard was the only check on that path.
findings.fix: Every state is checked against the ledger's state fields; anything else is no answer and nothing is sent.

findings.defect: GLiNER would be asked every workflow decision twice.
findings.scenario: Once the lake holds the workflow points, the lake source and the workflow source both yield them.
findings.cause: The lake source reads every gold point.
findings.fix: The lake source skips rows whose source is the workflow sets.

findings.defect: One-option decisions inflated a point's accuracy.
findings.scenario: solution.route: 102 of 220 rows have one option; a first-option model scored 0.95.
findings.cause: Accuracy counted decisions that cannot be answered wrong.
findings.fix: single_option counted, and accuracy_choices on the decisions with a choice.

measurements.name: the export
measurements.gate: Done when: the export's manifest lists every point with its counts
measurements.result: export_v2: 81,570 decisions of 17 points from 4,217 groups, each point's train and dev counts in the manifest, the same records in the chat, table and typed formats
limits: Invented tables, image sets and written journeys: not real tables.

measurements.name: the comparison per point
measurements.gate: Done when: a run's adapter can be compared per point
measurements.result: A stand-in model answering the first option, the 17 students and the rules compared on 340 dev decisions (20 a point): every one of the 17 points reported; the harness suite passed 17 of 17 on the changed prompt (HRN-021)
limits: No tuned model exists yet: the training run is the owner's.

outcome: A tuned model can now be trained on, and compared at, every decision point with a set, through the same request it learns from, without a state ever carrying more than the ledger keeps.
lessons: When a new source is read through a module path, every test that redirects the old paths must redirect the new one: a gitignored source makes the gate pass where the owner's tree fails.
A set played from sealed material is safe only while each sealed part has been read; make the check, not the memory, say so.
risks: The workflow points' rows include journeys a later measurement plays again: a model trained on them is measured on decisions it learned from.
